g.text: UML sequence - Internal payment, action approval and acknowledgement recovery
Issue shareable receiving reference as current owner
Current owned source + receiving reference + amount
Resolve active receiver and source product policy
Immutable quote and one payment identity
Review / create intent using stable request key
Bind one immutable quote to one intent
Fresh OIDC authorization code / PKCE / nonce
Commit ACCEPTED intent and audit/outbox intent
Accept stable workflow / original payment ID
Current permission, action proof and signed checks
Record nonexecution outcome; no journal effect
Retry or owned review; preserve original identity
Recheck expiry, restrictions, exact fee, funds and daily principal limit
Debit total / credit recipient / credit fee account
Balanced journal + immutable execution receipt + outbox
Retrieve receipt by original identity + full request digest
Relay persisted audit record with stable ID
Actual status, fees, date and original booking reference
Payment ID is the economic business identity.
Platform workflow ID is a distinct scheduling identity.
No external provider acknowledgement is used as internal settlement evidence.
